member.name: T:Api.Controllers.DirectoryController
member.summary: Directory operations: create, read, list children, rename, move and delete.
member.remarks:
Creating a root directory is a separate permission from creating a nested one. Anyone with Edit on a parent may add a subdirectory, but starting a new tree at the root is a tenant-level act, so it is gated by blocks-data::directory::create-root-directory and assigned to the owner role only.
Reads that the caller may not see report 404 rather than 403 throughout. Saying "forbidden" would confirm that a directory exists, which is enough to map a tree the caller cannot open.
